money.rounding: half away from zero (as Excel and the MF releases)

missing: null; a missing value is never 0

conversion.rule: the original number in млн. лв. ÷ 1.95583, rounded to 3 places after dividing

data.note: cumulative since 1 January; 2024 and 2025 are derived by the conversion from BGN

latest.rule: cum and prevYearCum: data at the latest month, rounded to 1 place; plan: plan2026 (budget status law); pctPlan and yoyPct: % from the unrounded cumulative values

pace.rule: % of the year's December cumulative value

reconcile.rule: the December report against Приложение 3 (annex3: budget status report for 2024, expected report for 2025)
